units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 8:3">Yeb. VIII, 3</cite> <he>עמוני ומ׳ אסורים וכ׳</he> marriage with an Ammonite or a Moabite is forbidden and the prohibition continues forever (with reference to their descendants; <cite ref="Deuteronomy 23:4">Deut. XXIII, 4</cite>); a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="M00386"><he>מוֹאָבִים</he></cite>, <he>מוֹאָבִיִּים</he>, <he>מוֹאָבִיִּין</he>.
Gen. R. s. 74; a. fr.—Fem. מוֹאָבִית.
<cite ref="Yevamot 69a:18">Yeb. 69ᵃ</cite>, a. e. (ref. to Deut. l. c.) <he>מואבי ולא מ׳</he> a male Moabite is excluded from intermarriage but not a female.
